description: A large image (~62% of the page) under a non-uniform luminosity mask (the left half white/visible, the right black/hidden).

expected.note: Construction fact: TWO image XObjects — the mask form (2x1px, the left pixel white, the right black) inside beginGroup/Luminosity, and the content (4x4px red) drawn OUTSIDE the group with /ExtGState /SMask pointing at that form. classifyImages() should give 'mask' for the mask form (maskEvidence='group', hard evidence) and 'content' for the content (a large area). decideExtractionStrategy() for the content should give 'region-render' (isMasked=true — direct extraction would give a version WITHOUT the mask). After the render: the left and right HALF of the result must be CLEARLY different (the mask was actually applied in the composition), not only the choice of strategy.
